DHCPv4::chaddr
       This command returns chaddr (client hardware address) from DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::chaddr

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns chaddr (client hardware address) from DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::chaddr

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns chaddr (client hardware address) from DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Chaddr [DHCPv4::chaddr]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
